### 🚀 Features

- support mail release binary installs ([77e3567](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/77e3567)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

### 🚀 Features

- **action**: publish monorepo packages from subdirectories ([aaa94dc](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/aaa94dc)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- support mail release binary installs ([77e3567](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/77e3567)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- add registry bulk download stream ([40240a1](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/40240a1)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **shell**: honor project toolchains in pantry env ([30a0b52](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/30a0b52)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- support zig 0.17 dev ([25bd6d7](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/25bd6d7)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- keep pantry installs native ([f3dbd4c](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/f3dbd4c)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- parallelize version update fetching ([58caf70](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/58caf70)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- preflight source package builds ([7e59f17](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/7e59f17)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- stabilize binary sync discovery ([b800fff](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/b800fff)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- verify metadata when S3 listing is unavailable ([b4e9f88](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/b4e9f88)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- guard binary metadata repairs ([69183cd](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/69183cd)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- harden binary registry sync ([998f89a](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/998f89a)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- isolate binary sync artifacts ([3574b5b](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/3574b5b)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- sync cmake binary registry versions ([b1a70a9](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/b1a70a9)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- finish zig fmt cleanup ([b648e3f](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/b648e3f)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- satisfy zig 0.17 fmt ([6cce507](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/6cce507)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- **zig**: replace `**` array repetition with @splat / comptime fill ([625e563](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/625e563)) _(by glennmichael123 <gtorregosa@gmail.com>)_

### ⚡ Performance Improvements

- **publish**: drop default inter-package throttle from 2000ms to 750ms ([d142778](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/d142778)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_

### 🤖 Continuous Integration

### 🚀 Features

- support package name aliases in short commit URLs ([4e641d4](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/4e641d4)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- add pkg-pr-new style short URLs for commit packages ([dda0e1a](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/dda0e1a)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- resolve Windows cross-compilation errors in io_helper and timespec usage ([1669bc5](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/1669bc5)) _(by glennmichael123 <gtorregosa@gmail.com>)_
- changelog extraction for versions with v prefix ([ad9039c](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/ad9039c)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- replace cryptic BufferTooSmall with clear tarball size error in publish:commit ([db51c02](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/db51c02)) _(by glennmichael123 <gtorregosa@gmail.com>)_
- sort aliases in generateIndex() for deterministic index.ts output ([c350510](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/c350510)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- remove hardcoded DOMAIN_TO_BIN, use getPrimaryBinary() from installer ([bde99de](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/bde99de)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- use full ts-pantry alias map (1700+ entries) instead of hardcoded 4 ([569522f](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/569522f)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- resolve package aliases (bun, zig, node) to domain names in action ([dc3e1db](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/dc3e1db)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- make alias tests resilient to LocalStorage list limitations ([7663d91](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/7663d91)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- use consistent prefix without trailing slash for S3/local list ([0211958](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/0211958)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- LocalStorage.list() emulates S3 prefix matching for partial paths ([6fa92f2](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/6fa92f2)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- remove duplicate metadata getter (already exists at line 337) ([53a71d1](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/53a71d1)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- properly split path and query string in S3 V4 signature ([9dcf9ea](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/9dcf9ea)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- include query params in S3 V4 signature for list operations ([1701d98](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/1701d98)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- short SHA resolution via direct S3 prefix search in route handler ([8448b09](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/8448b09)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- catch DynamoDB errors for short SHA lookups in getCommitPackage ([b65a97a](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/b65a97a)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- improve short SHA resolution with S3 fallback ([b31611b](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/b31611b)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
- resolve windows cross-compilation error in zig 0.16 ([198d4b0](https://github.com/home-lang/pantry/commit/198d4b0)) _(by Chris <chrisbreuer93@gmail.com>)_
